'''Ballas2''' is an unnamed character model in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''. He is a member of the [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]].

He is also available as a playable character in the official [[Multiplayer in GTA San Andreas|2 player mode]] exclusive to the [[PlayStation 2]] version of the game.

==Character==
===Appearance===
Ballas2 bears a slight overweight appearance, similarly to [[Fam1]]. He wears a purple bandana tied on the side, a black coat with multiple pockets, a white shirt, black pants, and white sneakers.

In ''The Definitive Edition'', his model has a few variants. He can sometimes be seen without his bandana, revealing a buzz cut. His coat can also be dark purple, black or dark navy blue. Most notably, the buttons on the coat are of a golden-yellow color.

In the [[Beta Content in GTA San Andreas/Characters#Ballas|beta]], Ballas2 bore a closer resemblance to [[Fam1]]'s final appearance, wearing a purple sweater over a white T-shirt, purple pants, and two purple bandanas, one tied around the head and another covering his face.
